description: Precedence weights for audit skill context variables. Used in scoring recommendations and resolving conflicts.

CRITICALITY_TIER.description: Direct security impact; highest business risk. Overrides all other variables.

COMPLIANCE_FRAMEWORK.description: Regulatory exposure; legal/financial consequences. Overrides lifecycle stage.

THREAT_LEVEL.description: Active risk; immediate attack surface. Overrides resource constraints and timeline.

PROFILE_STAGE.description: Organizational maturity; determines minimum audit depth and coverage.

TEAM_SCALE.description: Team size and organizational scope. Drives folder granularity.

AI_PATTERN.description: AI/ML involvement pattern. Determines folder structure (agents, embeddings, etc.).

SECURITY_WEIGHT.description: Security priority; applied to overall recommendation score.

COMPLIANCE_WEIGHT.description: Compliance priority; applied to overall recommendation score.

THREAT_WEIGHT.description: Threat assessment; applied to overall recommendation score.

TEAM_SCALE_FACTOR.description: Team organizational factor; applied to overall score.

PROFILE_STAGE_FACTOR.description: Lifecycle stage factor; applied to overall score.

TEST_MATURITY_FACTOR.description: Testing maturity factor; applied to overall score.

AI_PATTERN_FACTOR.description: AI pattern factor; applied to overall score.

rule1_security_compliance_override.description: Security (CRITICALITY_TIER) always overrides compliance if contradiction.

rule2_compliance_cascades.description: Compliance framework cannot be overridden by lifecycle stage.
rule2_compliance_cascades.rule: if (COMPLIANCE_FRAMEWORK != 'none') then apply all compliance rules even if PROFILE_STAGE='PoC'

rule3_threat_urgency_alignment.description: Threat level and remediation urgency must align; threat wins.
rule3_threat_urgency_alignment.rule: if (THREAT_LEVEL='critical' and REMEDIATION_URGENCY='deferred') then escalate urgency to 'immediate'

rule4_stage_scope.description: Lifecycle stage determines minimum audit depth and coverage.
rule4_stage_scope.rule: sandbox: depth >= 'shallow', coverage >= 50%; production: depth >= 'comprehensive', coverage >= 85%

rule5_resource_constraints.description: Resource constraints trade depth for speed, but never override compliance.
rule5_resource_constraints.rule: if (RESOURCE_CONSTRAINT='severe') then reduce AUDIT_DEPTH by one level, BUT maintain COMPLIANCE_FRAMEWORK requirements

interpretation.0-24: Minimal: Skip unless user explicitly requests

phasingTriggerFormula.description: Weighted formula for suggesting triage + full audit phasing
